info.title: Snipp.gg Relay API
info.description: First-party Snipp API for the full user experience. Includes uploads, posts, discover, likes, comments, blocks, and profile management.

servers.description: Default. Load-balanced across regions. No upload cap.
EU West regional endpoint. Pins uploads and storage to EU West.
US West regional endpoint. Pins uploads and storage to US West.
Alternative host. Capped at 100 MB per upload.

get.description: Retrieve user profile data. Includes badge flags and a `badges` object (ordered as `verified`, `staff`, `partner`, `bugHunterTier`, `translator`, `plus`). For non-self requests, public profile uploads are included by default as `publicUploads`.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: User ID or `@me` for the authenticated user

parameters.name: includePosts
parameters.description: Include `publicUploads` in the response. Defaults to `true` for non-self requests and `false` for `@me`.

parameters.name: postsLimit
parameters.description: Maximum number of `publicUploads` to return (1-50, default 50).

401.description: Unauthorized. No relay-key header or invalid relay key.

403.description: The target user has blocked you, or is suspended. A suspended user's response includes `suspended: true` and their `username`.

get.description: Fetch a post by its share code. Returns the post's metadata including its direct file URL, title, description, privacy level, and creation date. Private posts and drafts are only visible to the owner, and posts by a suspended user return `404` to everyone else.

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: The share code of the post

url.description: Direct URL to the primary file

urls.description: Ordered list of all file URLs. Only present on albums (more than one file).

isAlbum.description: True when the post contains more than one file.

files.description: Per-file metadata. Use `fileName` to address a file in /deleteUpload.

width.description: File width in pixels. Present per file when known; absent for older uploads.

height.description: File height in pixels. Present per file when known; absent for older uploads.

mime_type.description: File MIME type. Present per file when known; absent for older uploads.

size.description: File size in bytes. Present per file when known; absent for older uploads.

size_formatted.description: Human-readable file size. Present when size is known.

thumbnailUrl.description: URL to a generated thumbnail still frame. Present for video posts; signed (24-hour expiry) for private posts.

views.description: Total view count for the post (auto-incremented on this request when applicable).

likeCount.description: Total likes on the post. Omitted on team posts, which cannot be liked.

liked.description: Whether the requesting user has liked this post. Omitted on team posts, which cannot be liked.

author.description: The post's uploader. Null if the user has been deleted.

avatar.description: Avatar URL, or null if unset.

plus.description: Whether the author has Snipp PLUS.

priority.description: True when the post's video is served over priority delivery, false for standard delivery.

file.description: File metadata. May be absent for older uploads.

dimensions.description: Image dimensions. Only present for images and GIFs.

post.title: My screenshot
post.description: A cool screenshot

403.description: Post has been moderated, or its author has blocked you

moderated.description: Present and true when the post has been moderated

get.description: List public GIFs across Snipp, newest first, like a public GIF feed. No authentication required. Defaults to 30. Pass `?limit=N` (max 50) and `?offset=N` to page. Pass `?search=kitty cat` to match word prefixes in the title or description; multiple words are combined with AND, order independent.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum GIFs to return (1-50, default 30).

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of rows to skip for pagination (default 0).

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Filter to GIFs whose title or description has words starting with these terms (case-insensitive prefix match). Multiple space-separated words are combined with AND, order independent. Up to 6 words are used.

thumbnailUrl.description: Thumbnail URL. Only present when the post has a thumbnail.

title.description: Post title, or null when none is set

description.description: Post description, or null when none is set

hasMore.description: Whether another page is likely available.

post.description: Upload 1-50 image or video files. Supports PNG, JPG, WebP, GIF, MP4, MOV, and MKV. Every upload automatically creates a post. When sending multiple files, they are grouped into an album by default. File size limits depend on your plan. See [Plans](/concepts/plans) for details.

parameters.name: post-privacy
parameters.description: Privacy for the generated post: private (default), unlisted (accessible via link), or public (visible on Discover)

parameters.name: post-title
parameters.description: Post title (max 30 characters)

parameters.name: post-description
parameters.description: Post description (max 200 characters)

parameters.name: post-type
parameters.description: Only relevant when uploading 2+ files. `album` (default) groups all files into a single album post. `individual` creates a separate post per file.

parameters.name: include-metadata
parameters.description: By default, Snipp strips metadata (camera, GPS location, timestamp) to protect your privacy: metadata is removed from PNG, JPG, WebP and GIF images at any size without re-encoding, and container metadata is removed from videos during the MP4 remux. Set to `true` to keep the original metadata.

parameters.name: priority
parameters.description: Eligible videos use priority (adaptive bitrate) streaming by default, spending your priority minutes. Set to `false` to upload in standard quality instead and save your minutes. The post's `priority` field reflects whether the video ended up on adaptive streaming.

file.description: 1-50 image or video files. Use multiple `file` fields for multi-file uploads.

200.description: Upload successful. Response shape depends on whether 1 or multiple files were uploaded.

url.description: Direct URL to the uploaded file

priority.description: `true` when the upload is a video placed on priority (adaptive) streaming.

quota.description: Weekly byte quota. Present only when the file was rejected by the weekly usage limit.

used.description: Bytes already used in the current window. Present only when the file was rejected by the weekly usage limit.

resetsAt.description: When the current window resets. Present only when the file was rejected by the weekly usage limit.

post.description: Album mode returns `code`/`url`/`isAlbum`/`fileCount`. Individual mode returns `posts` array.

priority.description: Album mode: `true` when any file in the album is a video placed on priority (adaptive) streaming.

400.description: No file, unsupported type, or all files failed

403.description: Account suspended

413.description: File exceeds your plan's size limit

post.description: Convert one image or video to another format and get the converted file back in the response. Nothing is stored and no upload quota is consumed. Send the file as multipart/form-data and name the target format in the `convert-target` header. Images can become png, jpeg, webp, avif or gif; GIFs can become png, jpeg, webp, avif or mp4; videos can become mp4, mp3 or gif. Video to GIF requires Snipp+. Files are capped at 50 MB on the free plan, 20 GB on Snipp+, and 50 GB on Ultra and team keys. Video to GIF is limited to the first 10 seconds. Metadata is stripped from every converted file.

parameters.name: convert-target
parameters.description: The format to convert the file to.

file.description: The file to convert. Only the first file is read.

200.description: The converted file, returned as an attachment.

400.description: No file uploaded, unsupported source type, invalid target, or that source cannot become that target.

403.description: Account suspended, or Snipp+ is required for video to GIF.

413.description: File is over your plan's convert limit.

429.description: Rate limit exceeded. 10 conversions per minute.

get.description: List your personal uploads, newest first. Team posts are not included, and each file of an album is its own entry. Returns all by default. Pass `?limit=N` to cap the response (max 1000).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum uploads to return (1-1000). Omit for all.

code.description: Associated share code when a post exists

isAlbum.description: Whether the upload belongs to an album post

thumbnailUrl.description: Thumbnail URL for video posts. Omitted when the post has no thumbnail.

title.description: Post title, or null when none is set

size.description: Size in bytes of the whole post. Every file of an album carries the same value.

priority.description: True when the post's video is served over priority delivery, false for standard delivery.

403.description: Account suspended.

delete.description: Delete an uploaded file by filename.

parameters.name: file
parameters.description: Filename (32 hex chars + extension, e.g. a1b2c3d4e5f6...png)

400.description: Invalid file parameter

403.description: No permission to delete uploads, or the post is moderated

patch.description: Edit an existing upload's title, description, privacy level, or priority streaming. You must own the upload, or be a member of the owning team with a role other than viewer.

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: The share code of the upload to edit

parameters.name: post-privacy
parameters.description: New privacy level

parameters.name: priority
parameters.description: Toggle priority (adaptive) streaming for the post's videos. Returns 403 when no priority minutes remain.

title.description: New title (max 30 characters). Send empty string to clear. Use a form field rather than a header so emoji and accented characters are preserved.

description.description: New description (max 200 characters). Send empty string to clear. Use a form field rather than a header so emoji and accented characters are preserved.

priority.description: Whether the post's videos are on priority (adaptive) streaming after the edit.

400.description: Invalid parameters or no fields to update

403.description: Not your upload, the post is moderated, a restricted post cannot be made public, or no priority minutes remain.

post.description: Add one or more files to an existing album post (max 50 files total). New files inherit the post's privacy. You must own the post.

parameters.name: post-code
parameters.description: The share code of the post to append to

parameters.name: include-metadata
parameters.description: By default, Snipp strips metadata (camera, GPS location, timestamp) to protect your privacy: metadata is removed from PNG, JPG, WebP and GIF images at any size without re-encoding, and container metadata is removed from videos during the MP4 remux. Set to `true` to keep the original metadata.

parameters.name: priority
parameters.description: Appended videos use priority (adaptive) streaming by default, spending your priority minutes. Set to `false` to add them in standard quality instead. The post's `priority` field reflects whether any file in the album is on adaptive streaming.

file.description: 1 or more image or video files. Use multiple `file` fields for multi-file appends. Total file count after append cannot exceed 50.

fileCount.description: Total files in the album after append

priority.description: `true` when any file in the album is a video on priority (adaptive) streaming.

url.description: Direct URL. Signed with a 24-hour expiry if the post is private.

quota.description: Weekly byte quota. Present only when the file was rejected by the weekly usage limit.

used.description: Bytes already used in the current window. Present only when the file was rejected by the weekly usage limit.

resetsAt.description: When the current window resets. Present only when the file was rejected by the weekly usage limit.

400.description: Missing/invalid post-code, no file, album already full, would exceed 50-file cap, or all files failed

403.description: Account suspended, no permission to modify uploads, not the owner, or post is moderated

413.description: File exceeds your plan's size limit

get.description: Get public uploads for the discover feed. Returns up to 50 items. Blocked users are filtered both ways. Hits to this endpoint also count views toward each returned post (deduplicated per IP and post: 3 per hour).

thumbnailUrl.description: Thumbnail URL. Only present when the post has a thumbnail.

views.description: Total view count for the post (auto-incremented on this request when applicable).

liked.description: Whether the requesting user has liked this post.

priority.description: True when the post's video is served over priority delivery, false for standard delivery.

403.description: Account suspended

get.description: Returns the list of users you have blocked.

403.description: Account suspended.

post.description: Block a user by ID. Blocking is bidirectional in effect. Blocking an already-blocked user succeeds without error.

400.description: Invalid target or cannot block yourself

403.description: Account suspended

post.description: Unblock a user by ID. Unblocking a user who is not blocked succeeds without error.

400.description: Invalid target

403.description: Account suspended

post.description: Follow a user by ID. Following an already-followed user succeeds without error. You cannot follow yourself, suspended users, or users who have blocked you (or whom you have blocked).

400.description: Invalid target or cannot follow yourself

403.description: Blocked relationship or account suspended

post.description: Unfollow a user by ID, or remove one of your own followers. Exactly one of `targetId` or `removeFollower` must be provided. If both are present, `removeFollower` takes precedence.

removeFollower.description: The follower user ID to remove from your followers

400.description: Missing or non-numeric targetId and removeFollower

403.description: Account suspended

get.description: Return the list of users following the given profile. Capped at 200 results, newest first. Suspended users are excluded.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: User ID whose followers to list. Defaults to the authenticated user.

get.description: Return the list of users a given profile is following. Capped at 200 results, newest first. Suspended users are excluded.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: User ID whose following list to fetch. Defaults to the authenticated user.

post.description: Like a post. Calling it twice removes the like.

shareCode.description: The share code of the post

400.description: Invalid share code

403.description: Cannot like (suspended, moderated, team post, or blocked by author)

get.description: List comments on a post. Pass `shareCode` as a query parameter or `code` as a header.

parameters.name: shareCode
parameters.description: The share code of the post

likes.description: Number of likes on the comment

liked.description: Whether the authenticated user has liked the comment

400.description: Invalid share code

post.description: Add a comment to a post. Comments are limited to 200 characters. A post holds up to 500 comments.

400.description: Invalid input or post comment cap reached

403.description: Cannot comment (suspended, moderated, or blocked by author)

delete.description: Delete a comment by ID. The comment author or the post owner can delete a comment.

commentId.description: The UUID of the comment to delete

400.description: Invalid input

403.description: Not allowed to delete this comment

patch.description: Update profile fields. Send only the fields you want to change. Avatar and banner URLs must point to your own avatars/{userId}/ or banners/{userId}/ prefix on the Snipp CDN. Use /profile/avatar or /profile/banner to upload first.

customEmbed.description: PLUS-only. Custom embed configuration for share pages.

400.description: Validation error

403.description: PLUS-only feature requested without PLUS

post.description: Upload a new avatar. Multipart form upload. Image is square-cropped to the shorter side and stored under avatars/{userId}/. Accepts .png, .jpg, .webp, .gif up to 30 MB. Sets the field on your profile automatically.

400.description: No file or invalid type

post.description: Upload a new banner. Multipart form upload. Banner keeps its original aspect ratio and is stored under banners/{userId}/. Accepts .png, .jpg, .webp, .gif up to 30 MB. Sets the field on your profile automatically.

400.description: No file or invalid type

patch.description: Set your account color theme. PLUS-only. The theme is stored on your account and returned as theme on your /users/@me profile. It is never exposed on other users profiles.

theme.description: The color theme key to set.

400.description: Invalid theme

403.description: PLUS-only feature

post.description: Report a post for violating community guidelines. The post must not be private, a draft, or a team post, and not your own. Reports are reviewed by the moderation team.

code.description: The share code of the post to report

400.description: Missing or invalid code, or reason too long

403.description: Account suspended, post already moderated, reporting own post, or author has blocked you

404.description: Post not found, private, a draft, or a team post

post.description: Report a user for violating community guidelines. The user must exist and cannot be yourself. Reports are reviewed by the moderation team.

targetUserId.description: The ID of the user to report

400.description: Missing or invalid user, or reason too long

403.description: Account suspended, user already suspended, reporting yourself, or the user has blocked you

post.description: Report a comment for violating community guidelines. The comment must exist and cannot be your own. Reports are reviewed by the moderation team.

commentId.description: The ID of the comment to report

400.description: Invalid comment, or reason too long

403.description: Account suspended, reporting your own comment, moderated post, or blocked by the comment author

get.description: Returns the region serving the request. Useful for confirming which regional endpoint you hit, or for inspecting how `relay.snipp.gg` routed you. No authentication required.

region.description: Short region code, for example `eu-west-1` or `us-west-1`. `unknown` if unset.

country.description: Country name mapped from the region code. `null` if no mapping is available.

get.description: Returns the authenticated user's daily upload activity for the last 365 days, plus aggregate stats. This is the data behind the Upload Activity heatmap in the Snipp Console, exposed so you can rebuild it yourself. Days with no uploads are omitted from `history`.

history.description: Per-day upload activity, ascending by date. Only days with at least one upload are included.

bytes.description: Total bytes uploaded on this day.

count.description: Number of files uploaded on this day.

totalBytes.description: Total bytes uploaded across the window.

totalUploads.description: Total files uploaded across the window.

activeDays.description: Number of days with at least one upload.

currentStreak.description: Consecutive days with uploads ending today (UTC).

biggestDay.description: The single day with the most bytes uploaded. `null` if there is no activity.

windowDays.description: Size of the history window in days (always 365).

403.description: Account suspended

get.description: Returns the authenticated user's own analytics: posts, uploads, data uploaded, comments received, likes received and followers gained over time, plus totals. This is the data behind the Analytics page in the Snipp Console, exposed so you can rebuild it yourself. Requires an active PLUS subscription. All dates are UTC.

parameters.name: range
parameters.description: Window in days for the series and deltas. One of 7, 30, 90, 365. Defaults to 30 if omitted or invalid.

buckets.description: Today, last 7 days and last 30 days totals for each metric.

totals.description: Totals. `posts` and `views` are lifetime; `comments`, `likes` and `bytes` cover the fetch window only, which is twice the selected range with a floor of 30 days.

views.description: Total views across all your posts.

comments.description: Comments received on your posts within the fetch window.

likes.description: Likes received on your posts within the fetch window.

bytes.description: Bytes uploaded within the fetch window.

series.description: Daily values over the selected range. Each array has one entry per day, oldest first.

deltas.description: Current range window vs the preceding window of equal length.

current.description: Total for the current range window.

previous.description: Total for the preceding window of equal length.

change.description: Fractional change vs the previous window. `null` when the previous window was zero.

current.description: Total for the current range window.

previous.description: Total for the preceding window of equal length.

change.description: Fractional change vs the previous window. `null` when the previous window was zero.

current.description: Total for the current range window.

previous.description: Total for the preceding window of equal length.

change.description: Fractional change vs the previous window. `null` when the previous window was zero.

current.description: Total for the current range window.

previous.description: Total for the preceding window of equal length.

change.description: Fractional change vs the previous window. `null` when the previous window was zero.

current.description: Total for the current range window.

previous.description: Total for the preceding window of equal length.

change.description: Fractional change vs the previous window. `null` when the previous window was zero.

current.description: Total for the current range window.

previous.description: Total for the preceding window of equal length.

change.description: Fractional change vs the previous window. `null` when the previous window was zero.

current.description: Total for the current range window.

previous.description: Total for the preceding window of equal length.

change.description: Fractional change vs the previous window. `null` when the previous window was zero.

payout.description: Creator payout estimate for the current biweekly payout period, monetized creators only.

eligible.description: `true` only for monetized creators. `false` otherwise, with no other payout fields.

payout.description: Estimated dollar share of the creator pool this period. Live estimate, may change as engagement changes.

series.description: Daily payout score for the current payout period, oldest first.

403.description: Forbidden. The account is suspended or is not a PLUS subscriber.

get.description: List your notifications, newest first. Likes, comment likes and follows are aggregated into groups.

parameters.name: tab
parameters.description: Filter by category. `social` is follows, likes, comment likes and comments; `system` is everything else.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Cursor. Pass the `createdAt` of the last entry you received to fetch the next page.

get.description: Number of unread notifications. Cheap enough to poll for a badge.

post.description: Mark every unread notification as read.

get.description: Read your notification and email preferences.

post.description: Update notification and email preferences. Send only the keys you want to change; the rest keep their current value.

get.description: List every device signed in to your account on the website, most recently active first.

post.description: Log out one website session by `id`, or every website session with `all: true`. Your relay key is not a session and is never affected.

id.description: The session to log out, from `GET /sessions`.

all.description: Set to `true` to log out every website session instead of one.

count.description: Number of sessions logged out. Only returned with `all: true`.

400.description: Invalid session.

post.description: Like a comment. Calling it twice removes the like.

400.description: Invalid comment

403.description: Cannot like (suspended, moderated post, or blocked by the comment author)

Badges.description: Badge map used by profile surfaces. Order matches website profile rendering.

bugHunterTier.description: Bug hunter badge tier. 0 is no badge, 1 is Bug Hunter, 2 is Elite Bug Hunter.
Bug hunter badge tier. 0 is no badge, 1 is Bug Hunter, 2 is Elite Bug Hunter.

customEmbed.description: PLUS-only custom embed settings for share pages.

followerCount.description: Number of users following this account.

followingCount.description: Number of accounts this user follows.

theme.description: Your selected color theme. Self-only field. null if unset.

UserSubscription.description: Current subscription / plan lifecycle for the authenticated user. Self-only field.

status.description: Subscription status. `gifted` means the plan came from a redeemed code or admin comp. `null` for free users.

started_at.description: When the paid subscription began. `null` for free plans, and for gifted plans with no subscription behind them.

expires_at.description: When access ends or, for renewing subscriptions, the next billing date. `null` means no fixed expiry.

cancel_at_period_end.description: True when the user has canceled but still has access until `expires_at`. False for gifted plans with no subscription behind them.

gifted.description: True when the current plan comes from a redeemed gift code or admin-applied comp.

UserLimits.description: Plan limits and current weekly storage usage. Self-only field.

maxFileSize.description: Maximum size per file in bytes. 50 MB on free. On Snipp+ and Ultra it equals your weekly quota (20 GB on Snipp+, 50 GB on Ultra). Videos are capped at 30 GB on every plan.

usage.description: Weekly usage limit state. The window is a fixed 7-day period on a per-account schedule assigned at signup, and fully resets at that same day and time each week.

used.description: Bytes uploaded in the current window.

limit.description: Total bytes allowed per window. 2 GB free, 20 GB plus, 50 GB ultra.

usedPercent.description: Percentage of the window quota used, rounded to the nearest integer (0-100+; can exceed 100 when over quota).

windowStart.description: ISO timestamp when the current window started, derived from the account's fixed reset schedule. Present even when nothing has been uploaded yet.

windowEnd.description: ISO timestamp when the current window ends and usage resets. This is the account's fixed reset moment, the same day and time every week.

resetsInSeconds.description: Seconds until the current window resets.

blockedByYou.description: Whether you have blocked this user. Only present on non-self profiles.

following.description: Whether you (the requesting user) follow this user. Only present on non-self profiles.

Notification.description: A notification group. Likes, comment likes and follows are aggregated, so one entry can represent several underlying events.

id.description: ID of the most recent notification in the group

postCode.description: Share code of the related post

body.description: Comment excerpt, or the payout amount for payout notifications. Null when the related post is no longer visible to you, or every actor has been suspended.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of the most recent event in the group

actors.description: Users behind the notification, newest first. Capped at 10 even when actorCount is higher.

actorCount.description: Total number of distinct users in the group

postCount.description: Number of posts covered by the group (a single user liking several of your posts collapses into one entry)

postThumb.description: Thumbnail of the related post. Null for videos without a thumbnail, for moderated posts, and for posts no longer visible to you.

postText.description: Text of the related post (title, falling back to description). Null for moderated posts, posts no longer visible to you, and posts with no text.

notifications.description: In-app notification toggles. Moderation and account notifications cannot be disabled and are not listed here.

likes.description: Covers both post likes and comment likes

emails.description: Email toggles. Security, moderation and transactional emails cannot be disabled and are not listed here.

payouts.description: Creator payout and referral emails. On by default.

signIns.description: An email every time someone signs in to your account on the website. On by default.

browser.description: Browser name, or `null` when it cannot be recognized.

os.description: Operating system, or `null` when it cannot be recognized.

type.description: Defaults to desktop when the device cannot be recognized.

lastActive.description: When the device was last active. Updated at most every 5 minutes.

relayKeyAuth.name: relay-key
relayKeyAuth.description: Your Relay key from the Snipp Console
